class.name: Box3DSurfaceOverride3D
class.brief_description: Assigns Box3D surface materials from the scene tree.
class.description: Add [Box3DSurfaceOverride3D] as a child of a [CollisionObject3D] to assign a surface material or per-triangle map to that object's shapes.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies the current material and surface map to the parent collision object.

members.member: Surface material assigned to the parent body shape or shapes, stored as its permanent slot id and shown in the inspector as a name. [code]0[/code] clears the body-level override. An id rather than a name so that renaming the material in Project Settings does not detach every scene referencing it. Scenes authored before this change still load: their material name is resolved to an id the first time [method apply] runs, and re-saving the scene stores the id.
Body shape index to target, or [code]-1[/code] for all shapes.
Per-triangle surface map assigned to the targeted shared mesh shape or shapes.
